description: The TU Dortmund charging-profile team archives a postprocessing script for synchronizing electric-vehicle charging CSV measurements. Coverage is the associated laboratory measurement workflow. Its Zenodo record names version 1 and describes alignment of the charging-profile files associated with a laboratory study. The public code archive is free under CC BY 4.0. The script can help align power, current and quality measurements before deriving charging inputs for capacity or power-quality simulations. data-urbanev-shenzhen-ev-charging is a related field dataset, but no direct compatibility was tested. A caveat is that the release metadata do not specify every signal convention, timestamp rule or supported charger. Users must inspect the script and measurement metadata before adopting its output as a common time base. The own archive page and licence were checked, but the code ZIP was not downloaded or run. Runtime language and dependencies remain to be confirmed from the archive.
